title: An image that never loads keeps its loading tile and nothing of the transcripts left behind

source.name: an image's pending probe never holds the transcript that asked for it

steps.text:
Here is the diagram:

![never loads]({{heldImage}})

The image is still loading.

invariant: An image whose host never answers stays a loading tile, and switching away and back 80 times leaves the DOM nodes and the heap flat: no transcript is kept alive by the image's pending probe.
